title: [応用] CASE式で複合条件付き集計を行う
statement: 各tenantのメッセージ総数、未削除数、2026年4月以降の未削除数を1回のGROUP BYで集計します。SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)を使い、NULL判定と期間条件を組み合わせてください。
input: CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,deleted_at TEXT); INSERT INTO messages VALUES (1,1,'2026-03-01',NULL),(2,1,'2026-04-01',NULL),(3,1,'2026-04-02','2026-04-03'),(4,2,'2026-04-01',NULL),(5,2,'2026-05-01',NULL);
starterSql: SELECT tenant_id,COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN -- 未削除 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN -- 期間内かつ未削除 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_active_count FROM messages GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;
solutionSql: SELECT tenant_id,COUNT(*) total_count,SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) active_count,SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at>='2026-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) recent_active_count FROM messages GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;
